method: Same release probe built with baseline or candidate paper.rs; complete Store::preview_paper; temporary SQLite 10k/100k roots; three samples per workload per process; first pair followed by candidate/baseline/baseline/candidate in coordinated quiet window. Setup, expected-output reads, assertions and report serialization excluded; OS caches not flushed. Per-variant median aggregates nine samples. No picker, IPC, WebView, live provider, user database or RSS measurement. First pair had other test activity; all raw data retained. Production source hash excludes cfg(test) regression module; final rejection assertions strengthened after binaries were built, without changing production or probe.
